description: Arena Confirm Bug Loss. WHEN: an arena reviewer confirms (or reviews) another player's flagged bug-hit match. loss_caused_by_bug:true removes that loss from the official record everywhere (/r/stats, player-page widget, per-game). Players cannot confirm their own flags; reviewer key required. Example: arena_confirm_bug_loss {"match_id":"<match_id>"}

loss_caused_by_bug.description: true to confirm the loss was caused by a bug (removes it from the record); omit to just read the flag.

name: arena_confirm_bug_loss
title: Arena Confirm Bug Loss
